decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate is a flagship that draws directly on the firm's agricultural crate and injection-moulding expertise, so it can read the early harvest-season feedback and refine the design in-house.
Foldable large containers are a core competence for automotive and industrial customers, and having a dedicated page and several models signals solid assimilation and commercial value.
Stackable crates sit at the heart of the firm's existing knowledge base and serve its food and retail customers, so it can improve them easily and has little reason to withdraw them.
A medium-duty rackable pallet extends the firm's established pallet engineering, so its market results are easy to interpret and the line fits pooling and industrial demand.

The spill-retention pallet is more of a niche, safety-oriented product, but it builds on related pallet moulding know-how and is shown on its own page, so it is kept while the firm learns from early demand.
A pallet with load retainers is a modest variant of existing pallets that the firm can assimilate and adjust through its own engineering, so keeping it costs little.
